description: This PHP class extends a PDO cache resource to include GZIP compression and decompression capabilities for cached content.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo_Gzip
classes.description: A PDO cache resource class with GZIP compression/decompression for caching in Smarty templates.

methods.name: inputContent
methods.description: Encodes (compresses) the content before saving to database using gzip deflate.

methods.name: outputContent
methods.description: Decodes (decompresses) the content after retrieving from database using gzip inflate.
